headline: India exceeds expectations! GDP grows 7.8 percent: these are the main drivers of the economy
summary: India's real GDP grew 7.8% year on year in the April-June quarter, the first quarter of fiscal 2026/27, above economists' 7.5% forecast, according to official data released today.
why: GDP growth is the broadest measure of an economy's output and is closely watched by investors in Indian equities, bonds and the rupee. Stronger-than-expected growth can shape expectations for corporate earnings and monetary policy.
